name: Beck Bamberger
description: Beck is the founder of BAM, a PR agency for venture backed technology startups. In 2023, Beck sold the agency to focus on Bad Ideas Group, her VC fund that aims to help people and the planet live better and last longer. Beyond business, she is a licensed pilot, Krav Maga practitioner, chess aficionado, and global traveler. Holding a recent PhD in Organizational Change and Global Leadership, Beck also volunteers on the San Diego Police Department's Crisis Interventionist team.

investment_theses.quote: It sounds like a bad idea, which I like. Hence, Bad Ideas.
I love where there's a deep connective fiber to a certain audience. If you get in with one, you're easily sold to the next five, because they're all super connected.
I want to hear that intensity. That's what I want to hear where I'm like, you're gonna fight to the end because you know this is a $4 billion company.
